cause: CF2 fetch/quarantine and CF3 broker-oracle orchestration were rechecked after the runtime increment.

evidence.ref: 284 capability/native tests; 30 contract tests; frontend 169 files/1428 tests

impact: Focused CF2/CF3 evidence accepted; managed macOS native acceptance and full repository gate remain unverified.
lesson: Keep supply-chain and validation focused evidence separate from target-host containment and full-repository acceptance.

cause: CF2/CF3 implementation and focused tests passed, while the full repository gate exercised unsupported managed-macOS native sandbox paths and pre-existing Notebook planning contract mismatches.
impact: Focused capability/native suite 286 passed, focused contract suite 30 passed, frontend 169 files/1428 tests passed and typecheck passed. Full backend gate: 4025 passed, 24 failed, 8 skipped, 1 xfailed; failures are managed-macOS sandbox-exec limitation plus unmodified Notebook planning mismatches.
lesson: Keep focused capability evidence separate from full repository and target-host acceptance; unsupported containment must never become a successful fallback.

cause: Closed two binding gaps in the CF2 supply-chain decision and completed the CF4 broker-only dispatcher handoff.
impact: Focused capability/native suite 288 passed; focused contract/naming/trace suite 30 passed; frontend typecheck passed and frontend suite 169 files/1428 tests passed. Full repository gate remains not green from the previously recorded managed-macOS sandbox limitation and unmodified Notebook planning mismatches.
lesson: Quarantine identities and broker reports must bind the exact build, attestation, intent, plan, attempt, and policy; unsupported hosts remain typed non-success results.

cause: Hardened CF3 validation and CF4 terminal reconciliation boundaries.
impact: Capability/native suite 294 passed; frontend typecheck passed and frontend suite 169 files/1428 tests passed. Added broker report binding, source artifact binding, complete evidence coverage, receipt cross-journal binding, executor-key fencing, durable termination proof, and typed Artifact/Graph/Trace terminal reconciliation. Full repository and target-host native acceptance remain separate gates.
lesson: Terminal success or failure must require independently bound execution, termination, and side-effect reconciliation facts; local green tests do not prove native containment on this managed macOS host.

cause: Closed the cross-journal recovery gap for partial lease takeover and fenced irreconcilable epochs.
impact: Capability/native suite 296 passed; cross-journal recovery now repairs authorization-first crashes on the same attempt without spawning again, and irreconcilable epochs are fenced as dispatch_unknown. Full repository and target-host native acceptance remain separate gates.
lesson: Recovery must accept only a one-epoch authorization-first partial commit; all other journal divergence must become an isolated terminal state, never a new spawn.

cause: Bound CF3 validation cases to registered protocol check kinds and made incomplete protocol coverage inconclusive.
impact: Capability/native suite 298 passed; ValidationCase now declares a registered check kind, and CF3 service/runner cannot report passed when the frozen protocol is not fully covered. No new execution surface was added.
lesson: A registered validation protocol is only meaningful when server-side evidence covers every declared check family; missing coverage must remain inconclusive.

cause: Closed the client-owned CF4 completion path and bound explicit Notebook confirmation to a server-owned execution gateway seam.
impact: Bound V1.2 options reject client-supplied run and artifact facts before materialization. Explicit confirm-and-execute now constructs a server-owned approval record and exposes a typed gateway seam; the default missing gateway remains fail-closed. Capability/native suite 356 passed, naming gate 22 passed, frontend typecheck and 169-file/1428-test suite passed. Real supervisor, broker, and target-host containment acceptance remain separate gates.
lesson: A browser confirmation may select an execution mode, but only a server-owned approval record and trusted gateway may create dispatch facts; an unavailable gateway must not fall back to callback completion or in-process execution.

cause: The frozen Context Pack names two test paths that are absent from the checkout, and the full Python gate reaches a code execution test that is blocked by the managed macOS containment capability.
impact: CF2/CF3/CF4 and memory focused suites pass; full repository green and native code execution acceptance remain unverified on this host.
lesson: A frozen test list must be checked against the current checkout before claiming a gate, and sandbox-dependent failures on this managed macOS host remain environment evidence rather than product acceptance.

cause: The Notebook bridge eagerly imported the receipt module while the receipt module imported the Notebook package, causing collection-time circular import failure.
impact: The shared receipt error remains public while the bridge defers that import until validation; 12 import and Notebook receipt tests pass.
lesson: Cross-layer contract modules must not eagerly import through a package initializer that imports their consumer; preserve the public error type while deferring only the cyclic edge.

cause: The persistent dependency store previously ignored an invalid final JSONL fragment after a valid record, which could mask crash truncation or tampering.
impact: The store now fails closed on any invalid JSONL line, including an incomplete tail; CF2/CF3/CF4 capability tests pass.
lesson: Append-only persistence must reject every malformed line rather than treating a valid prefix as authoritative after an interrupted write.

cause: The fetch quarantine writer previously accepted an existing content-addressed hardlink and followed a symlinked ancestor when the bytes and digest matched.
impact: Fetch now rejects hardlink destinations and any symlink ancestor before writing or reusing quarantine bytes; dependency fetch/service suites pass.
lesson: Content addressing is not sufficient for filesystem containment; quarantine writers must verify link topology as well as bytes and identity.
